_comment: Named presets for Accursed Brood. Explicit CLI flags (--exp-mult, --zenny-mult, --class-mode, --gene-mode, --master-kits/--no-master-kits, guardrail flags) cleanly override preset defaults.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Curated balanced run: 12 Archetype classes, curated Master Kits, strict tiered Dragon Genes, all Anti-Softlock Guardrails ON, and standard randomized shops, treasure, and enemies.

fiesta.name: Fiesta
fiesta.description: Four-Job-Fiesta inspired class run: 12 Archetype classes, curated Master Kits, tiered Dragon Genes with light cross-tier bleed, all Anti-Softlock Guardrails ON, and 2x EXP/Zenny pacing.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.description: High-variance run: full flags at 0.85 randomness, legacy unconstrained characters & masters, flat Dragon Gene shuffle, tier & weapon guardrails relaxed, crash blacklist ON for PS1 stability.
